action: Prevent repeated collection after downstream failure
summary: Restore a validated same-date workflow artifact and resume from V4 build when collection and source-intake handoff already passed
issues: Downstream release failures caused health recovery to repeat external source collection
risks: Recollection remains allowed only when collection or V4 handoff did not pass or the artifact is missing or expired
lessons: Recovery must be stage-aware and artifact-backed
reusable_rules: Do not repeat collection for non-collection failures when a validated same-date intake artifact exists
